This project is a car log book simple html/css/js app, mainly used on  android mobiles.
It will be used in French only.
It must remain simple to use, and the UX/UI must always fit for android screens
All prompt must be js modals
Graphs must be scrollable, and legends must be displayed (and clickable to update/hide/show information on the graph) 
No documents will be stored in this app, only URL will be provided
